Reckless.source: Planar March live patch notes: Reckless Stance removed. No current skill activates stance:reckless.

Stance: Reckless.source: Planar March live patch notes: Reckless Stance removed and Reckless Strike added. Current skills have no Stance: Reckless page.

Mana Burst.source: Clean DB retains an inert spell with required_level=-1, no spell_classes, no teaching item, and no NPC-use row. Its old wiki page says it is no longer in the game. No named removal update appears in the Steam news API.

Mana Call.source: Clean DB retains an inert spell with required_level=-1, no spell_classes, no teaching item, and no NPC-use row. Its old wiki page says it is no longer in the game. No named removal update appears in the Steam news API. The hidden /preview and /rocfest commands still put it on a preset level-15 Arcanist hotbar. They overwrite the character and the save files, so they are not a way to learn it in play.

Pristine Ceremonial Ring.source: The ceremonial ring mold lists this ring as its second reward, but the forge always awards the first reward of a template (code fact smithing.awards_first_template_reward), and ancient coal only makes that ring blessed. No vendor, drop, quest, or other source gives it.

Unusual Copper Sceptre.source: The bronze sceptre mold lists this sceptre as its second reward, but the forge always awards the first reward of a template (code fact smithing.awards_first_template_reward), and better fuel only makes that sceptre blessed. No vendor, drop, quest, or other source gives it.

Ancient Sentinel.source: No scene, prefab, asset, or spawn table refers to the prefab, and a scan of the live game found no reference to it. The game places Sentinel in The Blight instead, which differs only in name, health, and attack damage. Simulated-player chat says that ancient sentinel is in The Blight and names it as the source of Blight Crystals and Ancient Pottery Shard.

An Angry Spirit.source: A player's page of 2024-10-12, with a screenshot, documented An Angry Spirit <Treasure Merchant> as a vendor in Shivering Step. NPC.cs builds that subtitle from the vendor description Treasure. The same Shivering Step vendor is now Enterprising Spirit. The prefab Character_Ghost_01 (1), a hostile ghost with the old name, has no reference in any asset and no spawn path.

Dream Invader.source: The level-8 prefab Dream Invader has no reference in any asset and no spawn path. Its scene copy in Fernalla's Portal keeps the object name Dream Invader, is named Invader of Dreams at level 24, and has the same loot. Simulated-player chat uses the name dream invader for The Fernallan Portal and for seven of those drops.

Braxonian Planar Guard.source: mapping.json excludes the dead base prefab with no spawn path. The clean DB generates the Fire and Ice variants with separate stable keys and pages.

Watchman.source: The prefabs Watchman and Gatekeeper are both named Watchman and have no reference in any asset. Their scene copies in Shivering Step match them in every exported field except the name: Bridgekeeper and Gatekeeper. The quest SHIVER-WATCHMAN is titled The Bridgekeeper. Simulated-player chat still says that watchman is in Shivering Step.
